main_text.l: Et sedet quietior. Non ferox caput supinat: Sed colit silentium Ore presso, dum secundos Sperat exitus malis. Et genas tradit cruentas Hostium libidini Verberandas, atque cunctis Obicit caput probris. Nam parentis vsque mentem Spectat almi: nec fore Perpetes quas mittit ille Gentibus plagas suis. Si truci dolore quenquam, Si premit laboribus, Illius statim peremnis Fert opem benignitas. Illius non vltro dextra Saevit, humanum genus Quum suis ferit flagellis, Et malis atrocibus. Facta sed severus horum Plectit arbiter mala: Qui terunt vinctos superbo, Turpe ceu cœnum, pede: Quique causas innocentum Pessimis calumniis Obruunt, vertuntque cuncta

page.notes: The verse lines are set in italic type with long s; the text is copied as printed (vsque, vltro, peremnis, Quum, cunctis, etc. kept). The line-by-line indentation is taken as the verse layout. Possible printing error: "Si truci dolore quenquam," followed by "Si premit laboribus," (the repetition of "Si" is as printed). The word "Saevit" is printed with the æ ligature as "Sæuit" in the scan; copied as Saevit with the ligature not reproduced. No further doubtful readings.
